cards.card_text: The prayer asks God to ___ us our debts, as we also have ___ our debtors.
cards.verse_text: And forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors.
cards.snippet: And forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors.

cards.card_text: So he calls in each of his master's debtors, and the first one owes a hundred measures of olive oil.
cards.verse_text: And he called in each one of his master’s debtors.
cards.snippet: And he called in each one of his master’s debtors.
